title: Pure Sasuke
summary: The Sasuke archetype unites the wind-and-shadow ninja warriors—Sasuke Samurai, Sasuke Samurai #2, Sasuke Samurai #3, Sasuke Samurai #4, and Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke! Each warrior specializes in dismantling a specific board state: Sasuke Samurai automatically destroys face-down Defense Position monsters before damage calculation without flipping them face-up, while Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke automatically destroys face-up Defense Position monsters before damage calculation! Pair them with Book of Moon, Book of Eclipse, and Quaking Mirror Force to force opposing boss monsters into Defense Position for instant destruction, or pay 800 LP with Sasuke Samurai #2 to lock out Spell and Trap activations before Xyz Summoning Blade Armor Ninja and Heroic Champion - Excalibur.

allow.Goblindbergh: Level 4 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons a Sasuke monster from your hand when Normal Summoned and switches to Defense Position, enabling instant Rank 4 Warrior Xyz plays.
allow.Book of Moon: Quick-Play Spell that flips any face-up opposing monster into face-down Defense Position so Sasuke Samurai can destroy it before damage calculation without triggering Flip effects.
allow.Book of Eclipse: Quick-Play Spell that flips all face-up monsters on the field into face-down Defense Position for Sasuke Samurai to slice through before the End Phase.
allow.Moon Mirror Shield: Equip Spell that guarantees Sasuke Samurai #3 and Sasuke Samurai #4 win every battle against Attack Position monsters.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches any Level 4 or lower Sasuke Warrior from your Deck.
allow.Quaking Mirror Force: Normal Trap that permanently flips all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls into face-down Defense Position—turning their entire board into free targets for Sasuke Samurai!
allow.Blade Armor Ninja: Rank 4 WIND Warrior Ninja Xyz (2 Level 4 Warrior monsters: Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke, Sasuke Samurai #4, or Goblindbergh) that detaches 1 material to grant a Ninja monster 2 attacks per Battle Phase!
allow.Heroic Champion - Excalibur: Rank 4 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (2 Level 4 Warrior monsters) that detaches 2 materials to double its original ATK to 4000 until the end of your opponent's turn.
allow.Ferocious Flame Swordsman: Link-2 Warrior that boosts all Warrior monsters on your field by 500 ATK.

main: Sasuke Samurai
Core Level 2 WIND Warrior: at the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, destroys that face-down monster immediately WITHOUT flipping it face-up!
Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke
Core Level 4 LIGHT Warrior (1800 ATK): at the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-up Defense Position monster, destroys that monster immediately before damage calculation!
Sasuke Samurai #4

Level 4 WIND Warrior (1200 ATK): at the start of the Damage Step when battling a monster, tosses a coin and calls it; if called right, immediately destroys the opponent's monster before damage calculation!
Sasuke Samurai #2
Level 1 WIND Warrior: once per turn during your Main Phase, pays 800 LP so neither player can activate Spell or Trap Cards until the End Phase—clearing the way for safe attacks and Xyz Summons!
Sasuke Samurai #3

Level 3 WIND Warrior: when this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent, forces your opponent to draw until they have 7 cards in their hand (capable of decking out opponents or setting up punish plays).
Goblindbergh
Normal Summon extender that Special Summons Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke or Sasuke Samurai #4 from your hand to assemble Rank 4 Blade Armor Ninja.
Book of Moon
Flips an opponent's boss monster face-down so Sasuke Samurai can destroy it without calculating damage.
Book of Eclipse
Flips the entire field face-down so Sasuke Samurai can clear opposing monsters before they draw in the End Phase.
Moon Mirror Shield
Ensures your Sasuke monsters always beat face-up Attack Position monsters in battle.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches any Sasuke Warrior or Goblindbergh from your Deck.
Quaking Mirror Force
Flips all attacking monsters your opponent controls into permanent face-down Defense Position for Sasuke Samurai to destroy on your turn.
extra: Rank 4 WIND Warrior Xyz (2 Level 4 Warrior monsters): detaches 1 material to allow Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke or itself to make a second attack during each Battle Phase!
Rank 4 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (2 Level 4 Warrior monsters) that detaches 2 materials to reach 4000 ATK.
Link-2 Warrior that boosts all Sasuke Warriors by 500 ATK and revives a Warrior when destroyed.
